title: Predicting CRISPR-Cas9 off-target effects in human primary cells using bidirectional LSTM with BERT embedding
authors: Orhan Sari, Ziying Liu, Youlian Pan, Xiaojian Shao
relevance_to_cellguide: CrisprBERT off-target predictor trained/evaluated specifically on CHANGE-seq primary-T-cell data (same 110 sgRNA/13-loci dataset as Özden et al.) plus DeepCRISPR HEK293/K562 data. Directly relevant alternative off-target scorer for the plan's specificity term, and its discussion section explicitly argues cell-type-specific chromatin/epigenomic context improves off-target prediction — supporting evidence for the plan's core ATAC hypothesis (H2).
